summary: Iter68 tested (backend + frontend). Backend: new pytest tests/test_iteration68_search.py, 24/24 pass. Covered: text search on code, client, custom_title, executive_name, agent_name, traveler and booking-confirmation guest_name, case- and accent-insensitive (jose/JOSÉ/pérez/angela/nunez/'nono ibanez'). Date search 'nov','noviembre','11/2026','04/Nov','04/11/2026','04/nov/26','04-11' matches trip 2026-11-04; non-matching dates ('05/Nov', other trips, no-date) are excluded. trip_from/trip_to is inclusive and leaves out quotations without a trip date. sort=trip_asc/desc puts no-date ones last. Month filter is ignored when q or a range is set. trip_start: dates.start, else the earliest custom_items checkin (servicios 2026-12-15 case); all 47 paquete quotations have trip_start == dates.start. Regression: test_iteration67_per_person.py + test_iteration67_e2e_api.py 25/25 pass (A–E totals unchanged); pricing_config restored (0.75). Frontend: list search icon does not overlap the text (icon ends at x=512, text starts at x=524). With month 2026-03 selected, typing 'jose' shows search-all-months-notice and month-group-search with the cross-month result. Clearing the text returns to the month view (month still 2026-03, notice hidden). Rows show row-traveler 'José Pérez', row-executive 'Agente: Ángela Núñez', row-agent 'Elaboró: María González', row-trip '04/Nov/26', and '—' when there is no date. '04/Nov' search works. trip-from/trip-to range and trip-range-clear work. quotations-sort trip_asc/trip_desc shows month-group-trip ordered correctly, no-date rows last. AddExecutiveControl tested in all 3 flows: paquete new (contacts-block and executive-block), servicios new (contacts-block → saved quotation keeps the new executive_id, verified via API), custom new (custom-contacts-block and custom-executive-block, auto-selected, custom-next enabled), paquete edit (contacts-block → saved, executive_id persisted), custom edit (custom-executive-block → saved, executive_id persisted, total unchanged 2640). Executives persisted in client.executives (verified via GET /api/clients). Existing quotations (2 each of paquete/servicios/personalizado) open in detail and edit pages with no page errors. All TEST_it68 data cleaned up.

minor.issue: Pre-existing, not from iter68: if hotel_name is missing or not in the package, it returns 500 (pricing.compute_quotation raises ValueError "Hotel '' not found in package") instead of 400 with a message.
Without search the list is capped at 500 docs by created_at, and sort=trip_* only reorders inside that window. Fine at current data size (65).

integration_issues.issue: Seen once and not reproduced. After save with a 1.5s wait, the contacts-block stayed and no 'Ejecutivo' step appeared, although the executive was saved on the client. A retry (4s wait / waiting for the PATCH response) worked. Likely a slow PATCH (a 401 + token refresh was seen in the console on load). The control shows no loading feedback other than the 'Guardando…' button label.

issues: The long search placeholder ('Código, cliente, paquete, pasajero, agente o fecha (ej. nov, 04/Nov)') is cut off on desktop, and the input gets narrow once the month filter + 'Todo el tiempo' pill are shown.
Mobile 390px: the 'Inicio del viaje Desde/Hasta' row wraps unevenly ('Hasta' label floats beside the first date input).

The header label 'Ejecutivo: María González' shows the Routiq agent who prepared the quotation, while the list now calls that person 'Elaboró' and uses 'Agente' for the agency executive. Wording is inconsistent.

action_items: Optional: return 400 instead of 500 for an invalid/missing hotel_name in paquete create (pre-existing).
Optional: shorten the search placeholder, fix the trip-range row wrapping on mobile, and align the 'Ejecutivo' label in the detail header with the list's 'Elaboró' wording.
critical_code_review_comments: AddExecutiveControl PATCHes the whole executives array built from the client object in memory. If another user or tab changed that client's executives in the meantime, those changes are overwritten. Consider a dedicated POST /clients/{id}/executives (append) endpoint.

The executive id is generated client-side with Math.random (12 hex chars). Low collision risk, but the backend Executive model already has a default uuid factory; letting the server assign the id would be safer.
QuotationsList fetch useEffect has no try/catch or loading/error state. An API error leaves stale items and no feedback.
list_quotations loads all tenant quotations into memory when searching (to_list(None)) and filters in Python. Fine for now; a Mongo text pre-filter would be needed at scale.

quotation_search.matches: short words like 'mar' or 'nov' match by substring in the haystack as well as by date, so a search for 'mar' also returns clients/titles containing 'mar' (e.g. 'Mariana'). This is acceptable but worth knowing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 timing issue seen once, not reproduced)

seed_data_creation: TEST_it68 clients/quotations created and deleted during the run; none left.

The servicios type drops custom_title (stored as None), so filter TEST data by client_snapshot.name. A paquete create via API needs hotel_name = an existing quotation's hotel_selected. Booking confirmation (guest_name) needs state=ganada first.
